messages:
anna_ml: Quick cross-env summary from today

We ran a lightweight trial of the new reduced-precision variant (awq-int8-lite) vs fp8 baseline across three canonical suites (hhqa, paraphrase, summarization). High-level: latency wins are big on hosted, accuracy deltas small but not uniform. Seeking an operational rollout + safe-fallback plan. :thinking:

liam_research: Can you paste the exact metrics and the evaluation prompt set used? Need numbers to decide thresholds.

anna_ml: Pasted raw numbers below (small table). golden set = gg_hhqa_v2 (2k prompts), paraphrase-bench-600, sumbench-1k.

```
metric                baseline(fp8)   awq-int8-lite   delta
hhqa accuracy (%)     86.5            85.7            -0.8
paraphrase F1         72.3            72.4            +0.1
summarization ROUGE-L 41.2            40.6            -0.6
latency p95 (hosted)  220ms           135ms           -38.6%
memory per model      9.2GB           4.0GB           -2.3x
```

derek_infra: Variant names + model hashes? We need to ensure registry entries and that private deployments have the quant kernels.

anna_ml: Variant tag: awq-int8-lite@rev-20260318; model hash sha256:abc123... (pushed to model-registry). Private package includes kernels for T4/A10 and nvrtc fallback.

jess_product: What's the acceptable user-facing risk here? Product expects <1.0% absolute drop on HHQA before we pause. Also want a plan to reduce exposed users if we see regression.

sam_ops: Proposal for rollout (suggested):
- Phase 0: internal smoke on private (0% traffic) for 24h sampling (liam owns)
- Phase 1: hosted-east-1 canary 1% traffic for 4h with active golden-eval hooks
- Phase 2: 5% for 12h if telemetries good
- Phase 3: 25% -> 50% -> 100% over days with guardrails

Rollback triggers (automated):
- absolute drop in hhqa >= 0.5% over the rolling 1h golden set
- increase in user visible error rate > 0.2%
- latency p95 regression > 20% vs baseline

Fallback behavior: immediate traffic siphon back to fp8 baseline; if hosted capacity constrained then route to dedicated fp8 pool, otherwise fallback to fp8 on private.

sam_ops: Example routing snippet we can push to routing service: 
```json
{
  "model": "awq-int8-lite@rev-20260318",
  "initial_traffic": 1,
  "steps": [1,5,25,50,100],
  "health_checks": {
    "golden_eval": {
      "set": "gg_hhqa_v2",
      "window_minutes": 60,
      "alert_threshold_abs_drop": 0.5
    },
    "latency_p95_pct": 20
  },
  "fallback": ["fp8@stable","fp8-dedicated","fp8-private"],
  "breakglass_command": "/rollcall rollback awq-int8-lite"
}
```

nina_sre: We need observability hooks in console: per-route golden set pass/fail, token-level cost change, and automated eval diffs persisted to 30d. Also add a repeatable eval job that runs every 30m during canary.

anna_ml: Will add the eval job and push live dashboards. Also adding a small set of focused golden prompts (10 high-sensitivity cases) with immediate alerting if any fail.

liam_research: I'll run the 24h internal private run tonight (start 02:00 UTC) and post extended sample (n=20k). If we see >0.6% drift on hhqa I'll stop and iterate on quant params.

derek_infra: Scheduling note: prefer canary window between 15:00-20:00 PST to minimize business-hour blast radius. I'll create the deployment ticket and include the rollback playbook.

ci-bot: deploy-bot: Hosted canary (1%) for awq-int8-lite@rev-20260318 deployed to hosted-east-1 — health checks running.

anna_ml: Thanks — please annotate the canary with the experimental_id: xenv-awq-20260318. I'll attach the eval job to that id.

jess_product: LGTM from Product. Keep me posted on any customer-exposed regressions. :rotating_light:

sam_ops: I'll wire the automatic siphon script to the routing service. Command to force immediate rollback (manual): `/rollcall rollback --model awq-int8-lite --scope hosted-east-1`

nina_sre: One ask: log the exact model hash in every request trace to make postmortem debugging trivial. Otherwise :+1:.

liam_research: Will post the 24h sample in this thread when done (ETA +26h).

anna_ml: Thanks team — plan stands. We'll iterate if golden evals flag.
